prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Deferred To Post-Waiting Stage: Move the sign-in step to occur right after the waiting screen before entering the home intro, allowing users to experience pet creation before registering.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Companion Profile", "body": "Sign in now to sync your new pet safely across all your devices."}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Persona Carousel Redesign: Redesign the pet choice screen into an interactive full-bleed carousel showing animated pet behaviors and trait cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion", "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_idle_preview", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "badge", "text": "Most Friendly", "style": "highlight"}]}}
2: [home, new_flow] Waiting Stage Progress Notification Flow: Introduce interactive setup activities and auto-notifications on the waiting screen while pet assets are generated.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "timer", "text": "Generating pet assets...", "style": "calm"}]}}
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Interaction Modes Screen: Add a new dedicated screen introducing key mouse gestures and keyboard shortcuts for interacting with the pet on desktop.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_interaction_guide", "home_intro"], "home_intro": {"headline": "Ready to Meet Your Companion", "body": "Your pet is now active on your desktop!"}}
4: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Value Proposition Copy: Clarify the differences between adopting a standard pet and generating a custom pet with direct path outcome descriptions.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Pet Experience", "hint": "Choose a pre-made pet for quick setup, or create a unique companion from photos."}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Sync Safety Hint: Add a reassurance hint explaining that signing in restores previous pets and preserves desktop settings across devices.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in ensures your pets and customizations are stored securely and synced everywhere."}}
6: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Processing Duration Estimate Notice: Display estimated processing time and real-time status cues when uploading custom pet photos.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Photo analysis usually takes 15-30 seconds. Higher quality photos produce better pets."}}
7: [home, notification] Pet Ready Desktop Push Notification: Enable a system notification that alerts the user when pet generation finishes if they switch away from the app.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "We're Crafting Your Companion", "hint": "Feel free to minimize this window. We'll alert you as soon as your pet is ready."}}
8: [finish, layout] Home Intro Split Guidance Layout: Reframe home intro screen using a two-column layout highlighting pet care quick actions alongside desktop shortcut keys.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Welcome Your New Companion", "body": "Learn how to summon, feed, and interact with your pet on your desktop."}}
9: [adoption, incentive] Certificate Naming Charm Incentive: Award an exclusive starter accessory badge right on the adoption certificate when the user gives their pet a name.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Starter Collar Unlocked", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering the sign-in step within onboarding is explicitly permitted.
Redesigning the pet selection screen into a carousel retains its core functionality.
Progress timer reflects a real wait while pet assets are being generated.
Adding a new onboarding screen before home intro is allowed.
Updated copy preserves both path choices clearly.
Sign-in hint provides account sync reassurance without asking for new personal data.
Photo processing estimate is informative and reflects actual creation wait time.
Adding system notifications during the waiting stage is permitted.
Redesigning the home intro screen layout within onboarding is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions free extras/unlocked items ('Starter Collar Unlocked').
